name: set_map_effect_position

stack.evidence: ScriptCommand_SetMapEffectPosition consumes an effect ID and three coordinates and decrements Script stackTop by four

notes: ScriptCommand_SetMapEffectPosition resolves effect_id through func_00177608 and, when the map-effect entry exists, converts x, y, and z to floats and stores them at offsets 0x00, 0x04, and 0x08 of the effect's runtime object. The JP corpus contains 164 calls, including position updates paired with command 163 spawn_map_effect.
